title: android/app/google-services.json (Firebase config incl. API key) is committed and present in HEAD
repro_steps: git ls-files android/app/google-services.json; git log --diff-filter=A -- android/app/google-services.json → 2242420 2026-08-14
evidence: Blob 72d73eb3 (path android/app/google-services.json) contains 1 AIza-class key (redacted in evidence/secret-scan-history-redacted.txt). Not gitignored (git check-ignore → none).
impact: Firebase Android API keys are designed to ship inside the APK and are not secrets per Google guidance, BUT only if API-key restrictions (Android app package+SHA-1, API restrictions) are set in Google Cloud. If unrestricted, anyone with the repo/APK can bill the project's Places/Maps quota.
notes: Engineering: verify the key's restrictions in Google Cloud Console (owner action; cannot verify from repo). Optionally move google-services.json to CI secrets. Not rotation-critical if restricted.

repro_steps: git log --all --reflog --find-object=9364721a6e8fb0e836735e556aacf6072fcf260f → c473ade; git branch -a --contains c473ade → (none); git ls-tree -r c473ade | grep 9364721a → .claude/settings.local.json; sha256(historical key) != sha256(current env key)

Other AIza hits in history are third-party minified bundles (blobs 03bbb967, c974cbe8 — unreachable) and the .env.local.example placeholder; not ours.

title: RLS / IDOR isolation — PASS on every user-owned table with B-owned counterpart rows present (record, not a defect)
repro_steps: node rls.mjs (PostgREST as A with anon key + A JWT, and as anon) over 45 tables; API IDOR probes node idor.mjs as A against B ids
evidence: evidence/rls-matrix.txt + rls-matrix.json: with B rows present (Bexists=1) — conversations, favorites, price_watches, bookings, plan_shares, review_shares, review_saves, message_feedback, notifications, notification_subscriptions, user_memory, user_preferences, chat_reads, user_events: A_read_other=0 rows, anon_read=0 rows, A_update_other=0 rows affected, A_delete_other=0 rows deleted, A_insert_as_B=42501. user_demographics/decision_evidence/account_status/platform_settings/moderation_queue/marketing_consent/commerce_*/governed_events/event_outbox/user_notes/contact_identity_index: 42501 permission denied for both A and anon (table grants revoked). Public-by-design reads (reviews, groups, review_likes, review_comments, profiles, user_follows) are readable but cross-user update/delete/insert all blocked. chat_messages/chat_participants/chat_threads: A reads the shared A-B thread only; anon denied; M (non-participant) gets 404 on GET/POST messages and read (evidence/idor-probes.txt). Admin routes: 12 endpoints × {A,M} → 403 with permission codes. Cron routes → 401 without/with wrong secret and with a user token. After A's foreign DELETE/PUT attempts, B's 2 conversations still exist (evidence/auth-lifecycle.txt, q8). profiles exposes no email column at all (42703).
impact: None. Documents the verified baseline so PASS 3 can diff.
notes: UNVERIFIED (no counterpart rows could be created via a user path): chat_blocks, chat_reports, contact_matches (0 rows; own-row policies exist), review_interactions (0 rows written — POST /api/reviews/[id]/interact accepted {type:view} with 200 but stored nothing; body shape not confirmed). Tables with RLS on and 0 policies are deny-all by construction for anon/authenticated regardless of rows (pg_policies + relrowsecurity in evidence/db-probe-summary.txt).

title: PUT /api/conversations with a foreign or unknown id answers 500 server_error instead of 404
repro_steps: As A: PUT /api/conversations {id:<B conv id>, title:"x"} → 500 {"error":"server_error"}; B row unchanged (q8)
evidence: src/app/api/conversations/route.ts:52-53 — .update().eq(id).eq(user_id).select().single(); 0 matching rows ⇒ PostgREST PGRST116 ⇒ treated as server error. evidence/idor-probes.txt line "A PUT /api/conversations 500".
impact: No data exposure (RLS + user_id filter hold). Wrong status class (5xx for a client condition) pollutes error monitoring and misleads clients into retrying.

title: DELETE /api/conversations returns {ok:true} when 0 rows matched (foreign or unknown id) — misleading success

title: /api/debug-places and /api/test-photos are unauthenticated in non-production and call paid providers (Google Places, Serper) on every hit; the production gate is CRON_SECRET-only and code-verified, not runtime-verified
repro_steps: curl GET http://localhost:3101/api/debug-places?q=x → 200 report incl. env presence {"GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY":"SET",...}; GET /api/test-photos → 200 with live Serper results (3 provider calls, ~1.3 s each)
evidence: src/app/api/debug-places/route.ts:32-33 (NODE_ENV !== production ⇒ open; else Bearer CRON_SECRET); src/app/api/test-photos/route.ts:5-13 same pattern; evidence/idor-probes.txt
